title: ACE runtime configuration (.ace.json)
description: Where ACE events come from and go to (RFC §10). Every MQ setting lives here; ACE messages never carry it (RFC §4).

sender.description: Sender identifier this session publishes under (RFC §5.3); required once outputs exist.

defaultActivation.description: Fallback activation when neither the input nor the message decides (RFC §8).

outputs.description: Publishing targets the ace_publish tool can address (RFC §19).

name.description: Input name (the key its transport is registered under) or output name (the tool's target).

transport.description: Transport kind; the keys below belong to that kind.

activation.description: Inputs only: receiver override (RFC §8); default delegates to the message.

stream.description: redis-streams: stream to read or append to.

group.description: redis-streams input: consumer group (created at the tail).

consumer.description: redis-streams input: consumer name, default ace-<pid>.

field.description: redis-streams: entry field carrying the ACE JSON, default message.

count.description: redis-streams input: entries per read, default 16.
